system.flavor:
Pin a runner against a wall with shots, keep a cornered thief from bolting out of the alley, or drive a stray horse into a pen and hold it there. Make one person stay put with their back to the stone.

Not enough to hold more than one person or to keep anyone pinned once you look away.

body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within ranged Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage. If the target ends beside an obstacle, it is Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Deal +1 Damage if the target cannot move directly away from you without entering an obstacle.

rider.title: Lock - Execution
rider.html: After a hit on a Locked target, you may end Lock to gain +1 Fortitude against that target until the start of your next turn.
